title: Same Raise. One Is $283K Richer 💸
description:
Mia and Sam get the same $500 a month raise.

Mia upgrades everything: new car, bigger apartment. Every dollar, gone.
Sam enjoys half and invests the other $250 a month.

At a 7% average return: $41,000 after 10 years, $123,000 after 20, and about $283,000 after 30. Sam only put in $90,000; the rest is compound interest.

Same job. Same raise. Completely different outcome.

So who are you, Mia or Sam? 👇

Follow for more numbers that change how you spend.

⚠️ For illustration only. Assumes a 7% average yearly return, which is not guaranteed. This is not financial advice.

#personalfinance #investing #compoundinterest #money #shorts
